supersedes_note: v1 (experiments/p1/run-accounting-contract-v1.json) is kept unchanged. v2 adds the two-layer state model, explicit partitions, the CORE_TOKENS_PARTIAL metric, cost_basis, raw.model, the incremental ledger and the no-sentinel rule (I6).
unit: TREATMENT_RUN = frozen task x frozen treatment x frozen executor binding x frozen shaping x rollout/repetition
run_identity_status: caller-supplied via run_id; sub-fields not yet split (UNMEASURED when run_id is null)

layer_1_executor_status.description: Termination reason of the executor loop. Not evidence of success (EXECUTOR_DONE != VERIFIED_SOLVED).
precedence: P1 provider_error: llm call failed after its retry policy (all attempts recorded)
P2 budget_exceeded: max_tokens reached by the lower bound of measured tokens
P3 budget_exceeded: max_cost_usd reached by the lower bound of known cost (known cost only)
P4 budget_unverifiable: a budget is set and the quantity it needs is unknown
P5 completed: a valid submit tool call (after the other tool calls of the same turn)
P6 error_limit_reached: consecutive format/tool errors reached error_limit
P7 max_steps_reached: logical successful calls reached max_steps
layer_1_executor_status.pre_run_validation: invalid parameters raise ValueError before any call; no record is produced and no resource is consumed
layer_1_executor_status.error_limit_note: error_limit_reached is an extension of v2 (not in v1 or in the D1-D7 specification); it implements mini-swe-agent max_consecutive_format_errors (default 3).

layer_2_outcome.description: Run result assigned only from an independent verifier verdict. Assigned by the evaluator, never by the core.

metric_v2.name: CORE_TOKENS_PARTIAL
metric_v2.definition: sum of total_tokens over all calls of the run; null if any call has unknown usage
metric_v2.may_be_reported_as: TOTAL_SYSTEM_TOKENS only when all 8 partitions are measured (none are null)
metric_v2.current_status: CORE_TOKENS_PARTIAL: only partition execution is measured

partition_rule: every partition is present in AgentResult.partitions; a value is an integer (measured) or null with a reason in unmeasured. Never 0 or empty string as placeholder.

partition_status_v2.context_input: null, reason: not separable from execution
partition_status_v2.verification: null, reason: no verifier in core
partition_status_v2.retry_replanning: null, reason: agent-level replanning absent; provider-level retries are reported in provider_attempts

failure_cost_rule: all consumed resources remain accounted for on failure or inconclusive. Enforced by an incremental ledger (call_started before the call, call_finished after, fsync per line). An interrupted call appears as in-flight and its consumption is declared unmeasured.
unmeasured_rule: a null field must have an entry in AgentResult.unmeasured with the reason. Sentinels 0, 0.0 and "" are forbidden for unmeasured values (invariant I6).
usage_rule: usage is the provider-reported usage. Missing usage is null, never 0. A call with any failed attempt has unknown usage for that attempt; total_tokens (and the other totals) are null when any call is incomplete (D5, I6). Budget decisions use the same lower bound.

lower_bound_rule.tokens_lower_bound: sum of total_tokens over calls whose usage was measured, including calls whose other attempts failed. It is a true lower bound of the tokens consumed. Null when no call returned usage (never 0). Reported even when total_tokens is null.
lower_bound_rule.failed_attempt_count: number of attempts that failed (provider errors inside retries). Measured count; 0 means none failed.
lower_bound_rule.why: a run recovered from a 429 keeps a usable lower bound instead of being discarded blindly; total_tokens stays null to avoid reporting an incomplete total as a measurement.

cost_basis.priced_by_table: cost > 0 from the litellm price table, estimate from provider usage
cost_basis.priced_zero_by_table: cost exactly 0.0 from the price table (e.g. ollama/* entries). This is a table fact, not a measured zero cost and not free-of-charge evidence.
cost_basis.unknown: no price entry; cost_usd is null
cost_basis.run_rule: unknown if any call is unknown or has unknown usage; priced_zero_by_table if all calls are zero; otherwise priced_by_table, with zero_priced_calls reported separately

remote_required.provider: measured if litellm exposes it, else null
remote_required.exact_model_requested: measured: model passed to the call
remote_required.exact_model_returned: measured: raw.model returned by the API (model_returned), else null
remote_required.request_parameters: not yet recorded in run output (gap, reported in unmeasured as run configuration)
remote_required.pricing_source: measured: litellm version of the bundled price table
remote_required.pricing_date: not measured: litellm does not expose the price date
remote_required.reasoning_tokens: measured if exposed, else null; never added to total_tokens
remote_required.api_usage_identifiers: measured: response id (api_id) if exposed, else null

local_required.wall_time: measured: wall_clock_ms per call and total_wall_clock_ms per run
local_required.token_telemetry: measured for remote providers via usage; local providers report what they expose

free_local_rule: FREE != ZERO COST. A priced_zero_by_table cost is reported with cost_basis and counted separately. Hardware, energy, setup, maintenance, verification and escalation remain separate and unmeasured. No hardware-to-token conversion.
cache_rule: cached_input_tokens is recorded when the provider exposes it. Cache creation, availability, amortization and matched cache state are not measured in this scope (null, with reason).
price_drift_rule: retain historical source and version (pricing_source). Future-price normalization is a separate analysis.

retry_rule.policy: exponential backoff base_delay_s * multiplier^(n-1), capped at max_delay_s, no jitter (reproducibility)
retry_rule.accounting: every attempt is recorded in CallRecord.attempts, including failed ones, with wall_clock_ms and error. provider_attempts (all attempts) and failed_attempt_count (failed ones) are reported at run level.

audit_rule: each tool call stores raw_output (complete, untruncated) and raw_sha256 in ToolEvent. The model receives the truncated observation. The ledger stores raw_output.
environment_rule: the tool subprocess environment is an allowlist: PATH, HOME, LANG, LC_ALL, TMPDIR, TERM, USER, plus non-interactive variables (PAGER, MANPAGER, GIT_PAGER, LESS, PIP_PROGRESS_BAR, TQDM_DISABLE). No API key of the host reaches the subprocess.

frozen_references.v1_unchanged: verified by test against sha256 recorded in tests/test_contract_v2.py
